# C Parser

This directory contains the input files for Flex and Bison as well as the files generated by them.

If `bison` and `flex` are installed, the C files can be generated using `make`.

# Temporary fix, proof output of vampire will be adjusted at a later point.

The parser accepts Vampire's partially applied equality `(= @ X)` and bare
negated equations `~ a = b`, constructing the same AST as their parenthesized
TPTP spellings. The scanner buffers tokens only for the formula of a `fof`
record: if it contains an actual `$ite(...)` application, that record is parsed
as TFF to support formula-valued conditions. Ordinary FOF records retain their
dialect. Quoted text, comments, and annotations do not trigger this promotion.
The lookahead buffer belongs to the individual parse context and is released
on both success and failure. TFF and THF records do not use lookahead.
